content.short: zkID Login is a multi-chain decentralized identity tool by zCloak Network that enables secure and easy login.
content.description: zkID Login is a product from zCloak Network that provides a multi-chain decentralized identity solution for secure, streamlined sign-in. The project currently operates as a browser extension, enabling users to store any Verifiable Credential in the zkID Wallet. Those credentials are accessible via standard APIs, which simplifies integration for developers and helps build interoperable identity experiences across supported networks.
